## Summary

Describe the user or engineering problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Lint passes locally
- [ ] No secret, `.env`, database, resume, or private project data is included
- [ ] UI changes were checked with keyboard and responsive layouts
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior

## Risk and rollback

Describe data migrations, external API behavior, security/privacy impact, and a
safe rollback path.
